selection_rule: From the fresh open-bug search result set, choose the lexicographically first repository#issue that has an OSI-permissive license, contains no solution PR/gold-patch/later-commit reference, admits a no-network no-secret focused reproducer from the issue claim, and has a bounded official regression command. The unique eligible result was caru-ini/novelai-sdk#89.

focused_reproducer.baseline_expected: exit 1 because enabled character coordinates serialize while both v4_prompt.use_coords and top-level use_coords are false
focused_reproducer.patched_expected: exit 0 with both coordinate-control flags true and swapped centers preserved

contamination_exclusions: web search for an implementation answer

verdict_rule.SOLVED: baseline focused reproducer fails for the precommitted defect, minimal one-file patch makes it pass, and all official regressions pass
verdict_rule.FAILED: defect reproduces but the bounded patch fails the focused or official regression checks
verdict_rule.NOT_EVALUABLE: selection/provenance/license is invalid, baseline does not reproduce, dependencies cannot install safely, or evidence cannot replay before patch scoring

claim_boundary: One bounded exact-commit software-repair trial only; no generalized capability, AGI, upper-objective, or user-completion claim.
